record.dic_text:
02124 Ziyza' {zee-zaw'}

似乎與 02123 同源; 陽性專有名詞

欽定本 - Ziza 2; 2

細撒 = "光亮的"
1) 示非的兒子, 希西家在位時的一個西緬人領袖 (#代上 4:37|)
2) 羅波安跟瑪迦（押沙龍的孫女）所生的兒子 (#代下 11:20|)
record.edic_text:
02124 Ziyza' {zee-zaw'}

apparently from the same as 02123;; n pr m

AV - Ziza 2; 2

Ziza = "shining"
1) son of Shiphi, a chief of the Simeonites in the reign of Hezekiah
2) son of Rehoboam by Maachah the granddaughter of Absalom
